class.name: GndSfxServer
class.brief_description: Ticks every player of the game on worker threads.
class.description: Made by the first player that needs it, as a child of the root - there is no autoload. The players do not process themselves: at the very end of each frame's [code]_process[/code] the server posts one tick over [code]gnd_sfx/worker_threads[/code] threads of [WorkerThreadPool] ([code]0[/code] ticks on the main thread), so it runs while the engine renders and steps the next physics frame. At the start of the next [code]_process[/code] it waits for it and copies the results into the audio nodes - only what changed. A player's API waits for a tick still running first. Only players with work are visited: a held loop or a sound between its fades costs nothing per frame.

method.name: wait_for_tick
method.description: Returns once no tick is running.
